text:
jamie: Quick heads-up — I need an expedited ok to push a hotfix to eu1. Embedding service intermittent timeouts under high concurrency. Will push image redwood/serving:emb-fix-2026-03-23, small config change (conn_timeout: 30s -> 45s). Target window: 21:30-22:00 UTC (now +20m). Canaries 5% then 50% then 100%.

sasha: what’s the rollback plan if latency regresses?

jamie: rollback is image revert to redwood/serving:stable-2026-03-18 — we’ve got automated rollback script in ops repo. Command: ```./ops/scripts/deploy_rollback.sh --env eu1 --svc embeds --image redwood/serving:stable-2026-03-18```

leo: oncall — can you confirm you’re available for the window? I’ll monitor SLOs.

leo: I’m here and watching. If p50 > 1200ms or error rate > 1% within 10min, we roll back.

maria: security/infra sanity check — any secret or KMS changes?

jamie: no KMS changes. Image only + small runtime flag. No infra migration. Quick smoke-tested in staging twice.

deploybot: Deploy request received: user=jamie env=eu1 service=embeds image=redwood/serving:emb-fix-2026-03-23 rollout=canary:5%->50%->100% checks=health,e2e,trace-alerts

jamie: Release notes (short): "embeds: reduce intermittent request timeouts under burst load by adjusting connection timeout handling and improving connection pooling."

sasha: ok from eng side. Need release note link in PR. Add minimal test logs.

jamie: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/412 — includes canary config and rollback script reference.

maria: +1 from security (checked image provenance). :thumbsup:

leo: +1 from oncall as long as we keep canary small and watch for 10m window. :eyes:

releasebot: Approvals recorded: eng:+1 (sasha), sec:+1 (maria), oncall:+1 (leo). Auto-unblock to proceed.

jamie: kicking it off now. Running deploy command: ```./ops/deploy --env=eu1 --service=embeds --image=redwood/serving:emb-fix-2026-03-23 --strategy=canary --steps=5,50,100```

deploybot: Canary 5% started (batch id=cb-176868). Health checks: running.

deploybot: Canary 5% health OK after 3m — cpu/mem normal, error-rate 0.08%, p95 slight bump +40ms. Proceeding to 50%.

jamie: monitoring traces — KV cache hit-rate steady. No error spikes on trace-alerts.

deploybot: Canary 50% started.

deploybot: Canary 50% health OK after 4m — metrics within expected. Rolling to 100%.

deploybot: Rollout complete: 100% -> image redwood/serving:emb-fix-2026-03-23 deployed to eu1. Post-deploy checks passing.

leo: Observability looks good. No complaints from customers in the last 8m.

sasha: thanks team. Can we freeze change notes until EOD and add a line to the weekly release email?

jamie: will do. I’ll add a short entry to release-notes.md and tag the PR.

maria: closing security review ticket.

releasebot: Deployment complete and recorded: deployment_id=dep-176868-embeds-2026-03-23. Archive entry created.

jamie: thanks everyone. If anything flares, we’ll revert with the rollback script. :rocket:
